I won't allow it.|audio = TwoXQuote.ogg|'''Two X''' in the second [[Outpost 16]] cutscene}} }} ==Description== '''Two X''' is an important figure within the story of Tower Defense Simulator as he is the creator of the ''"[[Meta]]'',"{{InlineQuote|The chaotic energy in the [[Nil Zone]] was beginning to corrupt the few that remained, including myself, so that was when '''Two X''' used the rest of his power to create Paradise, the seed of a growing tree that all realms are created from.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 21 ([[The Narratorium]])}} the figurative world tree from which all realms branch off from. He and his servant, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], dedicate their existence maintaining the stability of the [[Meta]] to keep it from collapsing. Like his brother, [[Lord Exo]], he is a primordial being that has existed since the [[Old World]], being one of the oldest beings in existence. However, it is unknown whether '''Two X''' and [[Lord Exo]] are eternal beings, or if they, too, have an origin. '''Two X''' was responsible for sealing [[Lord Exo]] inside of the [[God Cube]], as thousands of his strongest soldiers offered up their lives in sacrifice to create the cube.{{InlineQuote|Looking to his strongest fighters, they willingly sacrificed themselves to create a prison.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 15 ([[The Narratorium]])}} It has been stated that '''Two X''' derives his power from the sacrifices that his followers dedicate to him.{{InlineQuote|Their weapons were drawn-one siphoning the souls of the corrupted and the other was fueled by sacrifice. One takes, the other receives.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 14 ([[The Narratorium]])}} ==Personality== From what was shown in '''Two X's''' brief appearance in the [[Null & Void Event]], it can be gathered that he cares deeply for the [[Meta]] and the wellbeing of all life that resides within it. This is further backed by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s testimony of '''Two X''' from the [[Old World]], while [[Lord Exo]] thrives in chaos, '''Two X''' wanted to sustain life and believed everyone had a place in the world.{{InlineQuote|One wanted those who lived in the [[Old World]] to create a place of their own, while the other thought the only interesting world is one created from chaos.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 2 ([[The Narratorium]])}} Since the [[Meta]] is his domain of influence, '''Two X''' has been shown to understand what goes on inside the realms despite not being omnipresent, as during the [[Null & Void Event]] he knew about the plot to free [[Lord Exo]] despite not being in the [[Overworld]] nor the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].{{InlineQuote|Now after a certain amount of time that the writer doesn't want to explain, Paradise became a distant memory, and that's probably where [[Two X]] is trying to stop all realms from collapsing.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 28 ([[The Narratorium]])}} But his failure to prevent [[Lord Exo]]'s freedom doesn't mean '''Two X''' can be seen as ignorant or uncaring, rather '''Two X's''' failure is because he could not stop [[Lord Exo]] in his current state, as he dedicates his power to keeping the [[Meta]] intact. ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Abilities |- |'''Creation''': '''Two X''' is stated to be the creator of the [[Meta]], the network from which all realms in Tower Defense Simulator branch off. Paradise, the [[Overworld]], the [[Frost Realm]], the [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]], and many more realms are but a few worlds that exist within the [[Meta]]. |[[File:CardboardReframeUniverse.png|200px|center|thumb|'''Two X''' begins creating new realms.]] |- ! colspan="2" |Other |- |'''Creation of the God Cube''': Through thousands of his strongest soldiers offering up their lives in sacrifice, '''Two X''' was able to create the [[God Cube]], the device used to imprison [[Lord Exo]]'s soul. |[[File:GodCubeTeaser.gif|200px|center|thumb|"''Made from the souls of thousands that one man sacrificed.''"]] |- |'''Axis Blade''':[[File:AxisBladeCA.png|280px]] '''Two X''' wields a sword that shares a similar appearance to [[Lord Exo]]'s sword. |[[File:Twoxsword.jpg|200px|center|thumb|"''Maybe he was standing on a cliff with a galaxy in his hand aura farming or something.''" ]] |} ==Story== ===Old World=== Long ago, before the [[Old World]] even had a form, '''Two X''' and [[Lord Exo]] sealed the primordial Void away below the foundations of the world, fearing its unbridled power.{{InlineQuote|Before there was anything to call the Old World, the Void was already waiting in the dark. It cannot be considered a place or a creature, but something else entirely. It is a quiet hunger that lurks beneath the notice of every being, the presence that can be felt when nothing is around. The pale flora that blooms in a place where nothing exists is where it finds its peace. It is of one mind, though it wears a thousand faces. One could call it an incurable infection.
The brothers feared it, and even Lord Exo and Two X, who feared so little, understood that there was no killing a thing without a body. For the first and final time, they drove it deep down into the foundations of the world, into a dark so total its song could never be heard again.|[[Void Caster]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Afterward, the two brothers lived together in the [[Old World]], both overseeing all of creation.{{InlineQuote|Long ago, two brothers ruled over all creation.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 2 ([[The Narratorium]])}} But when [[Lord Exo]] began interfering with the harmony of life, finding chaos more fun than order, '''Two X''' began to clash with him. Their followers broke out into a devastating war that destroyed most of the [[Old World]]. '''Two X''' and his followers were looking like they were going to lose, but when all seemed lost, '''Two X's''' strongest soldiers offered up their lives to create the [[God Cube]], the saving grace that turned the tide of war. With [[Lord Exo]]'s soul imprisoned inside the cube, '''Two X''' and his followers reclaimed what was left of the [[Old World]]. ===Creation of the Meta=== With the [[Old World]] left in ruins, '''Two X''' created a new haven for the war's survivors, known as Paradise. This realm eventually became the seed of the tree of the [[Meta]], which all other realms in existence would grow and branch from. ===Null & Void=== '''Two X''' aura farms on a cliff in the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]][[File:TwoXBanlandsEvidence.png|280px]]While difficult to spot, close examination shows it highly resembles the tower cliffs found in the [[Banlands]] map, with '''Two X's''' spot making him be right above the entrance. However, due to the area above the entrance being drastically different, this appears to be a modified version of that map, potentially pointing to it not specifically being meant to be that map., aware of the [[Children of Exo]]'s plan to free [[Lord Exo]]. The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] comes to [[Two X]], asking for direction on what steps they should take. [[Two X]] responds to him, saying that he needs to protect The Meta; they cannot afford [[Lord Exo]]'s freedom, as it would destroy all of creation. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Maps}} CardboardNewBeginnings.png|'''Two X''' in [[The Narratorium]] CardboardWar.png|'''Two X''' in [[The Narratorium]] CardboardExoImprisoned.png|'''Two X''' in [[The Narratorium]] CardboardReframeUniverse.png|'''Two X''' in [[The Narratorium]] UnknownGarden2026Trivia1.png|'''Two X''' in [[Unknown Garden]] HardcoreReworkDI2.png|'''Two X''' in [[Outskirts Commune]] {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Two X''' in the second [[Outpost 16]] cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Appearances}} Twoxnullandvoid.jpg|'''Two X''' in the [[Null & Void Event]]. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} TwoXCA.jpeg|'''Two X''' on concept art.
